issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement incorrectly declares the attribute 'lectureName' as type int, while the textual description, example toString(), and the solution implementation use String for lectureName. This mismatch can confuse students about the correct data type to declare and use (including constructor parameter type) and may lead to compilation errors if they follow the UML literally.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML and any explicit type mentions in the problem statement to declare 'lectureName' as String (not int). Also verify the UML shows the correct types for all attributes to match the intended constructor and getter/setter signatures.
